cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding cake collapsed, but your final inspection caught it. You finally used the checkpoint I taught you; the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest. You used to wave things through because people were waiting; today you followed the process.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they agree with your inspection: reject the whole cake. Put 'full customer agreement' in the box I showed you. That's a complete result, for once.
